incident.observed: Required/BRAIN/CodeQL remained queued while the candidate stayed mergeable and current with main; a recovery-supervisor attempt had been cancelled.
incident.safe_action_taken: Preserved exact-head lineage and auto-merge, re-ran only the cancelled recovery-supervisor attempt, and did not bypass protected gates.

root_cause: External execution capacity can stall healthy exact-head checks; treating queue delay as code failure causes duplicate PRs, unnecessary rebases and unsafe pressure to bypass gates.
